==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
A woman and a man live with one another (I can't recall what they look like, so when I look back on the dream they just appear as dark faceless silhouettes). The man lives with the woman out of duty. The woman overtime has fallen in love with the man.

The man's duty is to help defend the woman in her dreams. The man has the ability to travel into the woman's dreams and to fight off her nightmares. Within the dream world the man takes the form of Popeye the Sailor Man.

The man's real name isn't Popeye, but that's what the woman calls him. The man is annoyed, because he feels like the woman only loves Popeye and doesn't really love him for who he truly is. From what I can recall from my dream, the man's suspicions do seem to be true.
